newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end sharply off as specs, locals sell.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end sharply off as specs, locals sell.

text.p: Speculative liquidation and local selling pressured FCOJ futures to end the day sharply lower in chart-driven trade, market sources said.
The action pressured November through key support at 116.50, electing stops and prompting the locals to join the selling.
Analysts said the technical indicators point to lower near-term prices, and pegged support at 112.40 in the most-active November contract.
The first notice day for the spot-September contract is September 3 and the last trading day September 10.
November fell 2.90 on the day to 114.80, having ranged from 117.50 to 114.75. September closed 2.90 weaker to 120.50, while the remaining months finished 2.35 to 2.15 lower.

Players dismissed Hurricane Edouard as it swept north of the Leeward Islands in the Caribean. "The least likely thing to be affected along the East Coast would be Florida citrus since the storm should move well north of this area," said Smith Barney meteorologist Jon Davis.
